metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2020 · The Call
metas.description: Two people live in different times. Seo-Yeon lives in the present and Young-Sook lives in the past. One phone call connects the two, and their lives are changed irrevocably.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2026 · Punjab '95
metas.description: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2021 · Jai Bhim
metas.description: When a tribal man is arrested for a case of alleged theft, his wife turns to a human-rights lawyer to help bring justice.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2021 · Drishyam 2
metas.description: A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Georgekutty be able to protect his family this time?

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2022 · Vikram
metas.description: A special investigator discovers a case of serial killings is not what it seems to be, and leading down this path is only going to end in a war between everyone involved.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2024 · Maharaja
metas.description: A barber seeks vengeance after his home is burglarized, cryptically telling police his "lakshmi" has been taken, leaving them uncertain if it's a person or object. His quest to recover the elusive "lakshmi" unfolds.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2021 · Sardar Udham
metas.description: A biopic detailing the 2 decades that Punjabi Sikh revolutionary, Udham Singh, spent planning the assassination of the man responsible for the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2022 · K.G.F: Chapter 2
metas.description: In the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky's name strikes fear into his foes, while the government sees him as a threat to law and order. Rocky must battle threats from all sides for unchallenged supremacy.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Dhurandhar: The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2022 · Drishyam 2
metas.description: A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Vijay Salgaonkar be able to protect his family this time?

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2024 · Lucky Baskhar
metas.description: A cash-strapped cashier working at a bank embarks on a risky investment scheme and soon gets drawn into the murky world of money laundering.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2023 · Sirf Ek Bandaa Kaafi Hai
metas.description: A common man with honesty and integrity can take on the system when he has truth on his side.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2022 · The Batman
metas.description: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, the Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2022 · Gangubai Kathiawadi
metas.description: Duped and sold to a brothel, a young woman fearlessly reclaims her power, using underworld connections to preside over the world she was once a pawn in.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2020 · The Dissident
metas.description: When Washington Post journalist Jamal Khashoggi disappears in Istanbul, his fiancée and dissidents around the world piece together the clues to a murder and expose a global cover up.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · One Battle After Another
metas.description: When their enemy resurfaces after 16 years, a group of ex-revolutionaries reunite to rescue the daughter of one of their own.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2023 · John Wick: Chapter 4
metas.description: John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2024 · Anatomy of a Fall
metas.description: A woman is suspected of murder after her husband's death; their half-blind son faces a moral dilemma as the main witness.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2023 · Sound of Freedom
metas.description: The incredible true story of a former government agent turned vigilante who embarks on a dangerous mission to rescue hundreds of children from traffickers.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2021 · Pushpa: The Rise - Part 1
metas.description: A labourer rises through the ranks of a red sandalwood smuggling syndicate, making some powerful enemies in the process.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · Argentina, 1985
metas.description: A team of lawyers takes on the heads of Argentina's bloody military dictatorship during the 1980s in a battle against odds and a race against time.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Killers of the Flower Moon
metas.description: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one - until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2020 · Promising Young Woman
metas.description: An unexpected encounter gives a wickedly smart and cunning woman a chance to right the wrongs from her past.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · No Other Choice
metas.description: After being fired, a man devises a unique plan to secure a new job: eliminate his competition.
